scope: Docker MSSQL software path: SELECT-only database boundary, real API/browser authorization, H2 persistent audit and screenshots

checks.name: mssql_select_only
assertions: DEMO-ASN-001 pending is visible
DEMO-ASN-002 failed is visible
DEMO-PM-001 pending is visible
UPDATE denied
DELETE denied
INSERT denied
no PROBE-DENY residue

checks.name: real_browser_and_permission
assertions: admin filters sync_status=pending,failed through the Chinese label 同步状态
multi-select OR semantics returns DEMO-ASN-001 pending and DEMO-ASN-002 failed
query, grid, detail fields, status options and actions are displayed in Chinese
detail exposes the Chinese label 报文摘要 without payload_json
DEMO-PM-001 list exposes product code, Chinese name and specification
DEMO-PM-001 detail exposes approval number, manufacturer, storage condition, UDI, schema version and 片/盒 packaging levels
page has no write actions
connector.read-only user has no menu after fresh login and refresh
connector.read-only user receives API 403

checks.name: h2_persistent_audit
assertions: list audit records connector/table/filter/result_count
detail audit records hit=true and result_count=1
audit diff contains no password, secret, payload_json or login password marker
audit persistence error is propagated by unit test

note: 客户正式接口库联调是可选增强，不影响 US-H8-004 软件路径关闭。
